decisions.reason: Although this submarine interior lighting line is relatively distant from the firm's core offer and was only lightly shown on the website, the firm's size, expansion, R&D capability and maritime customer base give it enough slack to continue testing the niche for now.

The medical examination light builds on the firm's established lighting capabilities and was given its own page, so its fit with existing know-how and the firm's current slack make continued retention more likely than withdrawal.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires strongly match the firm's industrial focus, engineering strengths and energy-efficient professional lighting strategy, so this line is likely to meet aspirations well enough to stay.
As a close-to-core relaunch of a previously popular designer task light, this product has the strongest internal legitimacy and the lowest apparent performance risk, making discontinuation unlikely.
